claim_under_attack: The packager's claims are tested against real externally-authored test protocols.
current_state_at_fire_start: evidence/phase0/sources/source-lock.v1.json lists exactly 1 source, reference/mvp20/fixtures/known-answer-protocol-package.v1.json (candidate_supplied_evidence_allowed=false, i.e. self-authored, internally compiled), backing the mission.md-documented n=5 hand-authored campaign/candidate/balance packets. Zero externally-authored protocol sources are present anywhere in the module.
finding: The formal, official-text CRO-protocol-standard corpus (ASTM D1654/B117/D3359/D4541/D610, ISO 9227/4628, SSPC-SP, NACE/AMPP SP0108) is uniformly paywalled with no free-redistribution path; that portion of the done_criterion's target space is genuinely BLOCKED_DATA. However the sweep also surfaced 2 public-domain US-government specifications (FED-STD-141D, MIL-DTL-24441D) and 2 CC-BY open-access papers (PMC11085474, PMC7825044) carrying real, quotable, rights-clean external protocol material -- MIL-DTL-24441D in particular is a same-chemistry-class (epoxy-polyamide marine coating) external specification with a real QC test battery. None of these 4 qualifying sources has yet been imported into the module's evidence corpus; that ingestion is the concrete next step and is filed as proposed_followups, not attempted in this fire (DATA-DIMENSION scope: sweep and record, not ingest).

proposed_followups.defect: The module's entire protocol/fixture evidence base is self-authored (n=5 known-answer packets over 1 self-authored fixture file; source-lock.v1.json lists zero externally-sourced entries), despite this fire identifying 2 public-domain (FED-STD-141D, MIL-DTL-24441D) and 2 CC-BY (PMC11085474, PMC7825044) rights-clean qualifying sources that were never imported.
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: At least 1 externally-authored, rights-clean protocol excerpt (e.g. MIL-DTL-24441D's Formula 150 QC battery, or PMC11085474's salt-spray Methods section) is imported into evidence/phase0/sources/imports/ with a rights receipt binding its license, and source-lock.v1.json's sources[] array gains a non-self-authored, rights_status=KNOWN entry, all within this module's write scope.

proposed_followups.defect: The 9 confirmed-paywalled ASTM/ISO/AMPP standards that anchor the packager's method-name vocabulary (cro_protocol.md's cited test methods) have never had a rights audit checking whether the module reproduces substantive standard TEXT (not just method numbers) from any of them, which would be a licence violation given every one is confirmed purchase-gated (S01-S09 in this fire's sweep).
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: An audit of cro_protocol.md, capture_template.json and falsification_protocol.json confirms every ASTM/ISO/NACE/SSPC method citation is limited to method NUMBER plus a generic, self-authored scope paraphrase, with zero verbatim reproduction of paywalled standard text; any violation found is removed or replaced.

proposed_followups.defect: DTIC report ADA578091 ('Galvanic Corrosion Test Method for Coatings and Materials') was identified as a plausible 5th public-domain US-government coating corrosion test method, but apps.dtic.mil returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch this fire, so its distribution statement could not be quoted verbatim and it was not counted as a qualifying find.
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: A follow-up fire fetches ADA578091 via DTIC's public search UI or an alternate mirror, quotes its distribution statement verbatim, and either appends it to the acquisition queue as a qualifying public-domain source or records the specific blocking reason if it is not in fact publicly redistributable.

qualifying_finds.structural_or_factor_overlap: Government test-method-index format (method number + title + scope + acceptance framing) is structurally close to what a packaged CRO protocol needs (named method + criteria); a genuine external, rights-clean protocol-structure template.
